label: Stale threshold (seconds)
description: Seconds of inactivity after which a translation key is considered stale (default: 30 days = 2592000)

label: Auto-flag threshold (seconds)
description: Seconds of inactivity before a translation key is automatically flagged for attention (null = disabled)

label: Report debounce (seconds)
description: Debounce interval for frontend missing-key reports

label: Missing key retention (seconds)
description: Seconds before unused missing-key rows are auto-cleaned (null = never)

label: Mail domain
description: Domain used for member email addresses and mail routing (e.g. vollbuild.ch). Seeded from MAIL_DOMAIN env var.

label: SMTP host
description: Outgoing SMTP server hostname. Seeded from SMTP_HOST or ZONEMTA_SMTP_HOST env var.

label: SMTP port
description: Outgoing SMTP server port (typically 587 for STARTTLS). Seeded from SMTP_PORT or ZONEMTA_SMTP_PORT env var.

label: SMTP username
description: System SMTP user (noreply address). Seeded from MAIL_DOMAIN env var as noreply@<domain>.

label: SMTP password
description: Password for system SMTP authentication. Generated once during seed.

label: Email schema
description: Pattern for member email addresses (e.g. firstname.lastname)

label: Club name
description: Name of the club, shown on invoices and member-facing pages

label: Currency
description: Default currency for invoices and financial reports

label: Notification sender email
description: From address for all system notification emails

label: Notification sender name
description: Display name for system notification emails
